title: Autouse client fixture's yielded test client is unused
evidence: test_app.py:17 `yield app.test_client()` but every test (e.g. test_health:24, test_create_book:31) calls `app.test_client()` directly instead of receiving the fixture value; the fixture only serves to patch DATABASE and init/teardown the test DB
suggestion: Have tests accept the `client` fixture argument and use it, so the yielded client is the one exercised

title: Idiomatic score is low (0.3) despite clean, working code
evidence: .idiomatic_cache.json score=0.3 (model=haiku); code uses raw sqlite3 + manual route handlers rather than a more idiomatic Flask pattern (blueprints, flask.g helpers, or an ORM)
suggestion: No action needed for correctness; informational for cross-run idiomatic comparison

title: init_db() runs at import time, creating books.db as a side effect of importing app
evidence: app.py:159 calls init_db() at module top level, so importing app (as test_app.py:4 does) writes a real books.db file in the workspace
suggestion: Guard DB creation behind `if __name__ == '__main__'` or a factory function; harmless here since tests patch DATABASE first
